summary.text: Darius Brown is a Democrat who represents the Second Senate District in the Delaware Senate, which includes New Castle, Wilmington and Edgemoor.

The Senate Democratic caucus's member page says he chairs the Judiciary Committee and the Elections and Government Affairs committee, and sits on the Joint Finance Committee and the Banking, Business, Insurance and Technology Committee.

paragraphs.text: The caucus page says Brown sponsored the Equal Rights Amendment to the state Constitution, the CROWN Act, the designation of Juneteenth as a state holiday, and a law on law enforcement body-worn cameras.

It also credits him with sponsoring the Adult Expungement Reform Act and the Clean Slate Act, which it says help remove barriers to education, employment and housing for more than 290,000 Delawareans.
The page describes him as the curator of an economic development strategy for the Second Senate District called Opportunity LIVES Here.
